contextGroups.name: hooks-context

Shared utilities go in .claude/hooks/lib/

Every AI-agent folder (.claude/, .codex/, .agents/, .opencode/) ships to other projects: keep it portable and configurable — no project names, absolute paths, or consumer-specific terms; project specifics belong in docs/project-config.json or project-reference docs
Hook code and tests ship to any project layout and OS — read docs/project-reference/integration-test-reference.md (Portable Test Contract) when writing or changing a hook test

contextGroups.name: agent-mirrors-context
rules: Every AI-agent folder (.claude/, .codex/, .agents/, .opencode/) ships to other projects: keep it portable and configurable — no project names, absolute paths, or consumer-specific terms; project specifics belong in docs/project-config.json or project-reference docs

A project-specific leak found in a mirror means the leak is in the .claude/** source — fix it there

contextGroups.name: shipped-tests
rules: Shipped tests under .claude/ must pass in any project layout on Windows, macOS and Linux: build a temp fixture project instead of reading this repo's config, docs, specs or git state (guard authoring-repo self-checks with the framework-repo signal); blank or delete inherited feature-switch and provider env keys and point HOME, USERPROFILE, TMPDIR, TEMP and TMP at the temp dir; before commit run node .claude/hooks/tests/run-all-tests.cjs on a machine that has those switches set, plus node .claude/skills/sync-codex/scripts/run-codex-sync.mjs --verify-only — read docs/project-reference/integration-test-reference.md (Portable Test Contract) when writing or changing a test

contextGroups.name: ui-ux-gate
rules: UI/UX gate: have UI-*, DD-* and CL-* in context BEFORE editing this surface; read the docs above unless already loaded
UI-1.1–UI-9.4 usability/a11y floor (pass/fail): SYNC:ui-ux-design-principles in .claude/skills/shared/sync-inline-versions.md
DD-1–DD-8 identity (design-knowledge.md): name subject/audience/job, write the Design Plan, pass the generic test
CL-1–CL-6 (checklist): §0.5 surface scope, B12–B15 load, E9–E11 container fit, §R forms, I15 dialog focus, K10 dead controls
Calibrate severity with design-review-calibration.md; brief > project design system/ADRs > these rules; no visual change = say skip

testing.commandsNote: **Platform (Windows):** invoke Python via `py -3` or `py` — NEVER `python3` (MS Store alias exits 49). Scripts resolve `python` then `py -3` (see `count-drift.test.cjs:40-45`). macOS/Linux: use `python3`.

experienceVerification.notApplicableReason: easy-claude is a framework repository with no user-facing application surface; adopters configure their own observable surfaces.

_techSpecScanNote: `techSpecScan` is DELIBERATELY OMITTED, not overlooked. It tells the tech-spec generator how to discover annotated tests (sourceRoot / fileExtensions / annotationPattern). This repo is a JavaScript + Python framework with no `[Trait]`-style test-annotation convention, so there is nothing to scan. Declaring a fabricated pattern would make the generator appear runnable while finding nothing. With the key absent, `node .claude/skills/tech-spec/scripts/generate-tech-specs.mjs` exits non-zero with 'Missing docs/project-config.json techSpecScan.{sourceRoot,fileExtensions,annotationPattern}' instead of reporting a false `status: ok`. When adding it, `annotationPattern` MUST expose exactly two capture groups: group 1 = trait name (must be `TestSpec` or `TechnicalSpec`), group 2 = the spec id (non-empty). The generator validates both and refuses to run otherwise.
